```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Under the policies of the present administration, many markets remain closed and U.S. trade deficits keep rising.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"New economic structures are needed to combine regional agreements with the development of global rules for opening the world economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Collaborating with the Congress, a Republican administration will engage the Latin American and the Asia-Pacific nations, including a new dialogue with India, about political economy and free trade.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As impoverished countries in Eurasia, the Middle East, and Africa accept freer economies, they will need the incentives of more open world markets.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States can encourage the European Union and its Asian friends and allies to open more sectors to cross-investment and competition with the aim of freer trans-oceanic trade.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans are confident that the worldwide trade agenda is full of promise.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"From the traditional goods of agriculture to the virtual links of e-commerce, gates can swing open.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Tariffs should be cut further.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States can back private sector efforts to streamline common standards and deregulate services, from finance to filmmaking.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"As the one economy with truly global reach, America can set the standards and be at the center of a worldwide web of trade, finance, and openness.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"If some nations choose to opt out, they will see how other countries accepting economic freedom will advance on their own, working together.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
